scope: Unmodified SMB geometry, inertia definitions and simulation control configuration, retained for parameter provenance only. This is not a Gazebo/ros2_control migration.
license_declaration: smb_description/package.xml and smb_lowlevel_controller/package.xml each declare MIT; no repository-wide LICENSE was present in the retrieved source. The copied model/configuration files remain unmodified.

adaptations.physics: New Bullet chassis box and four dynamic Y-axis cylinder wheels, attached by revolute hinge constraints with velocity motors. No chassis pose/velocity assignment during motion. No suspension.
adaptations.mass: 40 kg chassis plus four 5 kg wheels. Sensor meshes and their zero mass links are omitted.
adaptations.inertia: Analytic box/cylinder tensors. Upstream cylinder inertia macro places its axial term on Z while collision and wheel joint rotate about Y; Bullet puts the axial term on Y.
adaptations.motor_torque: 20 Nm per wheel is an explicit adapter assumption, configurable as max_wheel_torque. Upstream continuous joints and control_sim.yaml specify no effort limit.
adaptations.friction: Wheel Coulomb friction 1 follows upstream mu1/mu2. Bullet rolling/spinning coefficients 0.001 and ground friction 1 are adapter settings, not equivalent to Gazebo ODE kp/kd/minDepth.
adaptations.controller: v +/- omega*0.6604/2, divided by wheel radius. Upstream velocity and acceleration limits retained. Original control_sim.yaml uses cmd_vel_timeout=0.25 s; the new ROS 2 node defaults to command_timeout=0.3 s. The physics core has no wall-clock timeout.
adaptations.world: Configurable static plane and boxes with ray casting. This is not the original Clearpath playpen or DARPA cave world.
adaptations.frame: World-frame physical pose and velocity in core; ROS node converts twist to base_link.
adaptations.ground_height: Expected flat-ground base_link height about .24 m, from .19 radius minus -.05 wheel offset; unrelated to planner abstract robot_height .55 m.
